title: Apple’s most famous advert was shown nationally only once.
description:
Apple’s most famous advert was shown nationally only once. It aired during Super Bowl XVIII on CBS on 22 January 1984.

Director of the one minute advert, made with the agency Chiat/Day.

It had already run once in Idaho. Wikipedia lists KMVT in Twin Falls as the first broadcast, on 31 December 1983.

Apple’s board reportedly hated it. Wikipedia says the entire board disliked the commercial.

Nobody agrees what it cost. The New York Times reported $370,000, a 2005 account said $900,000, and Scott said under $250,000.

You’ll see why 1984 won’t be like ‘1984’.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1984_(advertisement) - Wikipedia; established director Ridley Scott, agency Chiat/Day, a one minute length, the first broadcast on KMVT in Twin Falls, Idaho on 31 December 1983, the only national airing during Super Bowl XVIII on CBS on 22 January 1984, that Apple’s board hated the commercial, the disputed cost (the New York Times reported $370,000, a 2005 account said $900,000, Scott said under $250,000), and the closing line about 24 January.
